## Budget vs. Revenue

This page examines the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide box office revenue. Figure @fig-budget-revenue shows how the two variables are related.

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
